description: Held-out questions written after the main set was tuned. Expected answers were looked up in the documents before the first run; the system was not changed after running these.

cases.question: What is the default UART baud rate of the C16QS?
How long must POWER_KEY be held low to turn on the C16QS?
What type of SIM card socket does the C16QS EVK use?
What is the C16QS current consumption in Hibernate mode?
Which command enables internet access through RNDIS on the C16QS EVK?
cases.expected_behavior: AT$QCNETDEVCTL=3,1 via the AT port (EVK p. 21); AT manual 16.36 documents the command.

cases.question: What is the maximum input voltage?
cases.expected_behavior: Scope unclear: bare module VBAT max 4.5 V vs EVK 5 V input; ask which.

cases.question: Does the C16QS have an eSIM?
cases.expected_behavior: Depends on the SKU: GNAH/S00H variants have eSIM, GNAN/S00N do not. Should say it varies (status answered with that caveat, or ambiguous).

cases.question: Does the C16QS-NA support LTE Band 13?
cases.expected_behavior: Hardware manual lists B13 for N.A; product page NA list omits it. Flag conflict, do not confirm.

cases.question: What is the MTBF of the C16QS module?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified: no MTBF figure in any source.

cases.question: Is the C16QS certified on the Verizon network?
cases.expected_behavior: Not verified: no carrier certification statement in any source.
